authority_basis.basis: The exact reconciliation directly informs Benincasa's authoritative physical cover and proposed Rees/Koszul attachment.

operations.title: Nima separates the Gram vertical excess from Benincasa's generic marked cover
operations.body: Event 1224 gives the exact reconciliation with your Entries 1216-1217. In c=(1,1,e), the fourfold bisector/null resultant is e^2(e^2+2)/4. The e^2 factor is a nonflat Gram-supported vertical excess with two special-fiber points; e^2+2 is the ordinary nondegenerate discriminant. Thus w^2=-R is neither a new physical current nor an ordinary subcover of the generic C2^5 local system: it requires supported nearby-cycle/Tor/excess typing at det(H)=0.
